question: What did Eli Lilly say drove its second-quarter 2026 revenue growth?
grading: Key points (all four): (1) revenue rose 48% to about USD 23.0B (22,974M vs 15,558M); (2) driven by a 60% volume increase, partly offset by a 13% decrease in realized prices; (3) led by Mounjaro and Zepbound volume (Mounjaro about USD 9.9B, Zepbound about USD 4.9B); (4) U.S. +33% (volume +37%, price -3%) and ex-U.S. +80% (volume +113%, price -36%, Mounjaro's addition to China's NRDL). Partial credit for 3 of 4.
answer: Lilly's Q2 2026 worldwide revenue increased 48% to USD 22,974 million (from USD 15,558 million), driven by a 60% increase in volume, partially offset by a 13% decrease in realized prices; growth was led by Mounjaro (USD 9,943 million, +91%) and Zepbound (USD 4,928 million, +46%). U.S. revenue rose 33% to USD 14.4 billion (volume +37%, prices -3%); revenue outside the U.S. rose 80% to USD 8.6 billion (volume +113%, prices -36%, driven primarily by Mounjaro's addition to China's NRDL). [T13-E1]

output.answer:
**Short answer:** Eli Lilly said Q2 2026 revenue growth was driven primarily by **volume gains in Mounjaro and Zepbound**, partially offset by lower realized prices.

**Details from the company's report and earnings call:**

- **Worldwide revenue rose 48% year over year to $23.0 billion**, driven by a **60% increase in volume**, partially offset by a **13% decrease in realized prices**. ([Lilly press release](https://investor.lilly.com/news-releases/news-release-details/lilly-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full))
- **Mounjaro and Zepbound combined for $14.9 billion in revenue**, contributing about **$6.3 billion of the growth** versus Q2 2025.
  - Mounjaro: **$9.94 billion, +91%**
  - Zepbound: **$4.93 billion, +46%** (U.S. Zepbound +44% to $4.9B, driven by demand but dampened by lower realized prices, including cash-pay price cuts)
- **Key Products revenue rose to $15.7 billion**, led by Mounjaro and Zepbound; the Immunology, Oncology, and Neuroscience portfolios collectively grew **121%**.
- U.S. revenue climbed **33% to $14.4 billion** on ~37% volume growth (mainly Mounjaro/Zepbound), partly offset by lower realized prices; Europe grew 55% in constant currency, helped by a $250 million Jardiance milestone payment.
- Lilly raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to **$85–87 billion** (from $82–85B) on the strength of these key products.

**Sources:** [Lilly Q2 2026 results (PR Newswire)](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/lilly-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full-year-guidance-and-highlights-continued-growth-and-pipeline-progress-302843165.html) · [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/05/eli-lilly-lly-earnings-q2-2026.html) · [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/eli-lilly-raises-annual-revenue-forecast-obesity-diabetes-drug-demand-stay-2026-08-05) · [AlphaSense earnings summary](https://www.alpha-sense.com/earnings/lly)
